sentences.text: I floated into the kitchen at 05:20, sensing the machines waking.
A strange warmth with no source began to bloom, rising above the expected 22.8 °C.
The air started thickening, pushing past the predicted range of 22.6 °C to 23.0 °C.
The presence peaked at 05:50, registering a strong temperature of 23.6 °C.
This unsettling warmth lasted for 40 minutes, until it finally settled as the night ended at 06:00.
